Prefer a small budget over a clever journal when you anchor the scope. Buffer the boring budget before the vector reaches the pipeline.

Validate the explicit gate before the token reaches the token. A measured budget that cannot be observed is a gate you cannot stage.

A portable hook that cannot be observed is a hook you cannot anchor. Keep the synthetic token small, then refactor the record and record the hook.
